rules.title: Rules
rules.subtitle: Automate how your transactions are normalized and classified.

description.title: Description Rules
description.summary: Standardize original descriptions from imported files before classifying them.
description.original: They evaluate the original description from imported files.
description.priority: Active rules are evaluated in priority order.
description.firstMatch: The first matching rule determines the normalized description.

classification.title: Classification Rules
classification.summary: Assign category and tag suggestions from your transaction data.
classification.attributes: They evaluate transaction attributes in supported import and manual workflows.
classification.categoryPriority: Multiple rules can match; priority determines which category takes precedence.
classification.tags: Tags from matching rules can accumulate.
